review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its simp declarations with sibling category files. The simp declarations are `forgetToTop_of`, `coe_forgetToTop`, and the `@[simps]` on `Iso.mk` and `alexDiscEquivPreord`. `coe_of` is deliberately not simp. Mathlib/Order/Category/Preord.lean and Frm.lean do the same, and Frm.lean comments "This is not `simp` to avoid rewriting in types of terms." `forgetToTop_of` rewrites to the canonical `↧α` form, so it is a reasonable orientation. `coe_forgetToTop` is simp and acts on types, which fits that comment less well. I found no practical problem with it, no competing rules and no cycle. I did not look at downstream uses beyond confirming that only Mathlib.lean imports this file, and I could not run Lean. I found no justified finding.
